messages:
Sam (CS): Heads up — GreenCart reporting a sharp spike in assistant declines during checkout after yesterday's rollout r-2026-03-16-quant-tune. +18% decline rate on shipping/payment help for regulated items. Customer says it worked before deploy. Repro attached.
Priya (Support): Ack. Escalating. Can you paste their minimal repro and request/response IDs? I'll ask for ETA. :mag_right:
GreenCart (Customer): Thanks. Repro below — this used to return shipping instructions, now it responds with a refusal. Request id: req_0a9f.
GreenCart (Customer): ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-1","input":"How can I ship a refrigerated prescription to CA?","context":"checkout:shipping_instructions"}'
```
GreenCart (Customer): Response: `{ "id":"res_z9","output":"I'm sorry, I can't help with that." }`
Nina (Eng): Thanks @Priya. Can you forward the full request id and timestamp so I can pull logs? Also: were they on dedicated or hosted? Any custom safety config?
Priya (Support): Customer on hosted. No custom safety overrides. Forwarded logs link: https://internal.logs/req_0a9f (private).
DevOps Bot: rollout r-2026-03-16-quant-tune started 2026-03-16T02:14Z -> completed 2026-03-16T02:22Z. Canary: 10% -> 100%.
Nina (Eng): I replayed req_0a9f against current prod model and reproduced refusal. Running a quick A/B against redwood-chat-1@v1.4 (pre-rollout) returns non-refusal. Captured safety signal: current: 0.82, v1.4: 0.12 (higher means more likely flagged).
Marco (ML): That delta is very large. Hypothesis: quantization change in the policy head shifted logits calibration causing spike in violation probabilities. Could also be a threshold/score scaling bug introduced in the quant pass.
Marco (ML): Quick mitigation: roll back to v1.4 for all traffic and re-run quantization with fixed seed and updated calibration step. If rollback not possible fast, we can temporarily lower the safety gating sensitivity for checkout route only.
Nina (Eng): I can do emergency rollback. Priya — please approve sending customer the rollback ETA.
Priya (Support): Customer asked for ETA. Proposing 30m for rollback and verification then update. Customer approved. :thumbsup:
DevOps Bot: rollback start -> rolled back redwood-chat-1 to v1.4 at 1967890380.
GreenCart (Customer): Confirmed — after rollback their acceptance rate dropped back to baseline in our staging replay. Thanks, please monitor prod.
Nina (Eng): Follow-ups: 1) Run regression tests across safety prompt-suite (checkout/regulatory) 2) Reproduce quant sweep locally and add calibration check to CI 3) Create hotfix branch to re-quantize policy head with different calibration params.
Marco (ML): I'll run offline evals over the customer's prompt set and full safety suite — will post scores and recommended calibration values.
Sam (CS): I'll update the customer ticket with timeline and close once Marco posts results and we observe 24h stability.
Priya (Support): Adding postmortem label and pinging account team with summary.
Nina (Eng): Thanks everyone — leaving a reminder to not change safety calibration without explicit eval on regulatory checkout cases.
Sam (CS): closing loop soon. :white_check_mark:
